gallery.title: File:Modern Architecture.jpg
gallery.description: The Uganda National Museum Building is the First Modern Achitecture building of the 20th century in Uganda and one of the earliest cast-in-place concrete structures in Kampla. It influenced the design of other government and institutional buildings throughout the country. It was designed by a Ernst May german architect in 1947. uptodate the building is still authentic and still serves the purpose built for.

gallery.title: File:Obote Independance Terrazo stone Plaque.jpg
gallery.description: This is a unique Terrazo stone plaque that was placed at the Independance pavillion of science and Industry section at the Uganda Museum by the ,Then Prime Minister Dr. Milton Apollo Obote to mark the attainment of Uganda's Independance on 8th October 1962.. it is well decorated with Yellow, Red and Black stones the colors that represent the Uganda National Flag...

gallery.title: File:Uganda at Independence.jpg
gallery.description: The Independance Pavilion of science and Industry section at the Uganda Museum was opened on the eve of the Uganda Independance by Hon. Prime Minister of Uganda Milton Apollo Obote that was 8th October 1962
